snippet.title: Worshippers Of Cthulhu 1.0 OUT NOW - FINAL TRAILER - FULL RELEASE
snippet.description:
Worshippers Of Cthulhu 1.0 OUT NOW - FINAL TRAILER - FULL RELEASE
After months of hard work, we’re proud to announce that our game is finally OUT on Steam in its full release version! 

Thank you to everyone who supported us during Early Access / development – we couldn’t have done it without you. 🙌

🎮 PLAY the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807150/Worshippers_of_Cthulhu/

Don’t forget to like and leave a comment– it helps us more than you think! ❤️

#indiegame #steamrelease #gamedev
